name: BITS
summary: Sydney dialup + permanent 56k + hosting ISP (from Mar 1996); ISP arm wound down late 2000s, company still trading as computer + test-equipment retailer (BITS Technology).

events.details: BITS was first established Mar 1996 (ISP brand); company Bits Pty Ltd ACN 059639771 incorporated 31 Mar 1993.

ISP arm wound down: bits.com.au was still the ISP through ~2007, an 'Online Shopping / Shareware' retail site by 2008, and 'BITS Computer Storage, Peripherals, Accessories' by Jan 2010; the company pivoted to computer/test-equipment retail (not defunct).
Still trading as 'BITS Computer and Test Equipment - BITS Technology' (bits.com.au live, 2026).
